officialTitle: Brigatinib versus Crizotinib in ALK-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

design.blinding: Open-label; PFS by blinded independent central review
design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 275 patients underwent randomization; 137 were assigned to brigatinib and 138 to crizotinib.
design.notes: First interim analysis at approximately 50% of expected events.

clinicalQuestion: Is brigatinib superior to crizotinib in ALK inhibitor-naive advanced ALK-positive NSCLC?

pico.population: Advanced ALK-positive NSCLC without prior ALK inhibitor
pico.outcomes: Primary: BICR PFS. Secondary: ORR, intracranial response

arms.label: Brigatinib
arms.dosing: 180 mg once daily after a 7-day lead-in at 90 mg
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive brigatinib at a dose of 180 mg once daily (with a 7-day lead-in period at 90 mg)

arms.label: Crizotinib
arms.doseSourceQuote: or crizotinib at a dose of 250 mg twice daily

publications.title: Brigatinib versus Crizotinib in ALK-Positive Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: First interim analysis

outcomes.endpointLabel: PFS by blinded independent central review
outcomes.sourceQuote: The rate of progression-free survival was higher with brigatinib than with crizotinib (estimated 12-month progression-free survival, 67% [95% confidence interval {CI}, 56 to 75] vs. 43% [95% CI, 32 to 53]; hazard ratio for disease progression or death, 0.49 [95% CI, 0.33 to 0.74]; P<0.001 by the log-rank test).
The confirmed objective response rate was 71% (95% CI, 62 to 78) with brigatinib and 60% (95% CI, 51 to 68) with crizotinib
the confirmed rate of intracranial response among patients with measurable lesions was 78% (95% CI, 52 to 94) and 29% (95% CI, 11 to 52), respectively.

safety.sourceQuote: No new safety concerns were noted.

limitations: Reported at first interim analysis with short follow-up

clinicalImplications.text: Supports brigatinib as a first-line next-generation ALK TKI option with intracranial activity superior to crizotinib.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Brigatinib uses a 7-day lower-dose lead-in before full dosing.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 30280657. Later ALTA-1L updates not ingested.
